decompositions.approach: Skeleton of the Balasubramanian–Soundararajan / Szegedy argument for Graham's conjecture. Hole 1 (Farey structure): if every ratio a / gcd(a, b) over A is at most m, then every quotient a / b is a reduced fraction u / v with 1 ≤ u, v ≤ m.

nodes.claim: \forall A \subset \mathbb{N}\ \text{finite},\ \forall m \in \mathbb{N}:\ 0 \notin A,\ \bigl(\forall a, b \in A,\ a \le m \cdot \gcd(a,b)\bigr) \Rightarrow \forall a, b \in A\ \exists\, u, v \in \mathbb{N}:\ 0 < u \le m,\ 0 < v \le m,\ \gcd(u,v) = 1,\ a v = b u
nodes.label: Farey structure of bounded quotients

nodes.claim: \Bigl(\forall B \subset \mathbb{N}\ \text{finite}:\ 0 \notin B,\ |B| = |A|,\ \gcd(B) = 1 \Rightarrow \exists\, a, b \in B:\ \gcd(a,b) \le \bigl\lfloor \tfrac{a}{|B|} \bigr\rfloor\Bigr) \Rightarrow \exists\, a, b \in A:\ \gcd(a,b) \le \Bigl\lfloor \frac{a}{|A|} \Bigr\rfloor
nodes.label: Reduction to primitive sets, division in N

nodes.claim: \Bigl(\forall B \subset \mathbb{N}\ \text{finite}:\ 0 \notin B,\ |B| = |A|,\ \gcd(B) = 1 \Rightarrow \exists\, a, b \in B:\ \gcd(a,b) \le \tfrac{a}{|B|}\Bigr) \Rightarrow \exists\, a, b \in A:\ \gcd(a,b) \le \frac{a}{|A|}
nodes.label: Reduction to primitive sets

nodes.claim: 0 \notin A,\ A \ne \emptyset,\ \gcd(A) = 1,\ \bigl(\forall a, b \in A\ \exists\, u, v:\ 0 < u \le |A|,\ 0 < v \le |A|,\ \gcd(u,v) = 1,\ a v = b u\bigr) \Rightarrow \exists\, a, b \in A:\ \gcd(a,b) \le \Bigl\lfloor \frac{a}{|A|} \Bigr\rfloor
nodes.label: Primitive sets with Farey quotients, division in N

nodes.claim: 0 \notin A,\ A \ne \emptyset,\ \gcd(A) = 1,\ \bigl(\forall a, b \in A\ \exists\, u, v:\ 0 < u \le |A|,\ 0 < v \le |A|,\ \gcd(u,v) = 1,\ a v = b u\bigr) \Rightarrow \exists\, a, b \in A:\ \gcd(a,b) \le \frac{a}{|A|}
